description: Pulse and SSU logger with four channels and Modbus RTU
source: Analo Sistemas de Energia, "Registrador de Pulsos – Tabela de registradores Modbus", revision 2002.09.01

sources.title: Registrador de Pulsos – Tabela de registradores Modbus
sources.note: register table, register formats and mass memory description

notes: Analo Registrador de Pulsos. The registers of the manufacturer's Modbus table, translated to English.

Addresses are the 'Endereço' column of the table (the 'Registrador' column is one higher). Values are 16-bit; several registers pack two bytes, described as high byte / low byte. Values split in LSB and MSB registers are read here as 32-bit, low word first.
The Analo signature registers spell "ANALO" and the hardware model has a fixed value: both are given as references to recognise the device.
The table gives no units or scaling for the counters and SSU values: they are the raw values of the meter's serial user output and of the pulse inputs.
The mass memory (from 128 to 65407; 16320 records of 4 registers, newest first) is not in this map; its record formats are described in the table.

registers.description: High byte: year x 16 + month; low byte: day.
